svg.title: STRATEGY / RESILION — original animated profile panel
Resilion: supply-chain risk intelligence for India's crude-oil imports
svg.desc: Project card for Resilion, in progress. A Gemini Risk Watcher agent turns news (GDELT headlines, Guardian articles) into structured disruption events. In this illustrative event, a news event lands on the Strait of Hormuz corridor in the NetworkX supply graph (seeded with 13 nodes and 19 edges); a 2-hop traversal lights the refineries it supplies (Jamnagar, Panipat, Mumbai) and then the industries they serve (power, petrochemicals, transport fuel, LPG). The Red Sea corridor is untouched. A human approval console is planned, drawn dashed. Stack: Python, NetworkX, Gemini, React.
svg.text: Supply-chain risk intelligence for India's crude-oil
